STR fuse (AMI IN row) -> relay R3
FAN fuse (AMI IN row) -> relay R4
FAN2 fuse (AMI IN row) -> relay R5
PWR fuse (AMI IN row) -> relay R6
BUS1 fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 8 AWG
RTR fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 10 AWG
AM1 fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 8 AWG
AM2 fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 10 AWG
JB1 fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 6 AWG
EPS fuse (AMI OUT row) -> harness, 8 AWG
ACPS (A/C pressure switch) fuse, fed from the heater relay 87
1/0 battery feed in, M8 stud on the bar

relay coil plug lead to Link Aux 3
